response_entity.entity_name: Patch area, semi-annual delp biomass and fecundity, 1996-2006 southern California

parser_semantics.patch_number: exact non-empty string after outer-whitespace stripping only; no aliases, fuzzy matching or numeric coercion
parser_semantics.year: strict base-10 integer token with no decimal/exponent syntax; allowed values exactly 1996 through 2006
parser_semantics.semester: strict base-10 integer token; allowed values exactly 1 or 2, where 1=Jan-Jun and 2=Jul-Dec
parser_semantics.patch_area: finite non-negative decimal number; EML declares no missing-value code
parser_semantics.patch_biomass: finite non-negative decimal number; EML declares no missing-value code
parser_semantics.patch_fecundity: finite non-negative decimal number; EML declares no missing-value code

endpoint: For each transition, among patches with recorded patch_biomass == 0 at source period t and a valid record at t+1, target y=1 iff recorded patch_biomass > 0 at t+1; otherwise y=0. This is recorded canopy reappearance/non-reappearance, not latent biological colonisation/absence.
observation_policy: Because EML declares no missing-value codes, every required token must parse under the frozen field rule. Blank/non-finite/unknown tokens fail closed and do not become zero. Duplicate patch-period records or coordinate disagreement beyond frozen geometry identity fail closed.
